name: How can I fix a clogged bathroom sink myself?

mainEntity.name: How can I fix a clogged bathroom sink myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: For minor clogs, you can try several DIY methods. A mixture of baking soda and vinegar poured down the drain, followed by hot water, can sometimes dissolve blockages. A drain snake or a plunger can also be effective in dislodging physical obstructions. Ensure you're using the correct plunging technique by creating a tight seal around the drain. Avoid using chemical drain cleaners frequently, as they can damage pipes over time and may not be effective for severe clogs. If these methods fail, a professional plumber can diagnose and resolve the issue safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can try baking soda and vinegar, a drain snake, or a plunger for minor clogs. Avoid chemical drain cleaners.
